label: Shared hemispheric Indigenous testimonial critique of colonial hypocrisy
description: Like Guaman Poma’s Andean letter to the Crown, Zitkala-Ša’s essays deployed the colonizer’s language and print culture to expose Christian-settler violence.
dialecticalTension: Trans-hemispheric continuity of Indigenous testimonial sovereignty.

label: Foreshadowed Deloria’s Dakota critique of missionary assimilation and federal policy
description: Zitkala-Ša’s "Why I Am a Pagan" and National Council of American Indians advocacy anticipated fellow Yankton/Standing Rock Dakota thinker Vine Deloria Jr.’s critique of colonial religion.
dialecticalTension: Establishes Dakota philosophical resistance from early 20th c. to Red Power era.

label: Pioneered Native American women’s philosophical memoir and cultural defense
description: Gunn Allen recognized Zitkala-Ša as a key foremother of Native American women’s intellectual and spiritual resistance.
dialecticalTension: Links early 20th-c. Dakota critique to late 20th-c. Native feminist philosophy.
